_description: FORGE gate config — the SINGLE source of project-stack-GATING truth the security hooks source on the hot path (pre-tool-use.sh, pre-mcp-gate.sh, .githooks/pre-commit). Hot-path-only: doc-rendering keys live in forge.config.json (D-11 split). Edit this file, not the executable hooks, to change protected domains / gated MCP / linters. skill-gate.md's Domain Routing table is RENDERED from this file (scripts/forge/render-skill-gate.sh) — do not hand-edit the rendered region. See .claude/rules/skill-gate.md.
_fidelity_note: file_patterns / command_patterns are grep -E REGEX (not globs) — preserved verbatim from the pre-refactor hooks so behavior is byte-identical. A glob→regex translation in a security hot-path hook was rejected as a behavior-change risk (Plan 22-02).
